QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Quartermaster Harpoon
QuestInfo.0: HQ is in much better shape thanks to Piston's operations. What should you do next? Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bReclamation HQ Commander Barracks#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea said HQ lacked supplies because the supply route had been disrupted. She told you to go help Quartermaster #bHarpoon#k. Harpoon is right outside the barracks.
QuestInfo.2: You met Quartermaster Harpoon at the #bReclamation HQ#k.

0.0: Did the mission go smoothly? Excellent, thank you. What a great help you've been to the Reclamation HQ. The front lines are more stable now, due to the #rNova warriors, Maple World warriors, and many others playing an active part#k.
0.1: However, we are still #rsorely lacking in supplies#k right now because of how long we had to survive with broken supply lines. The enemy is mounting pressure, and we have more soldiers here to look after now.
0.2: Check in with #b#p3001008##k, our quartermaster, and help out with our supply problems.

yes.0: #b#p3001008##k is outside the barracks. One of the twins is Harpoon.

no.0: Hm? Do you have something else to do? Whatever it is, handle it and hurry back.

npc.0: #b#p3001008##k is outside the barracks. One of the twins is Harpoon.
